anchor_selection.policy: bench-static score: coverage 0.50, continuity 0.15, confidence 0.05, area 0.05, centrality 0.10, stability 0.15

bar_identity.criterion: 2-5 shared frames; per-frame mask IoU>=0.90, bbox IoU>=0.65, containment>=0.99, centroid<=0.01 diagonal, area ratio<=1.10; immediate successor transition required

bench_identity.framewise_selection: dynamic programming with source-track switch penalty

merge_audit.criterion: strict non-overlap stitching plus audited same-bench identity stitching

thresholds.bar_person_policy: original association plus strict audited bar handoff; person unchanged
